items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: Do you remember Mutt Carry came up with Johnny Dodds in a four-piece band with Mary and Mary Mack?

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. That's when I started making records. Sort of the ragtime period. That's when I started making records. And he was very interesting. He was a very nice fellow. And he joined Mary Mack. And I was just sitting here trying to think. I don't know whether one time he came in. Mary Mack used to always have little dance bands, and she would bring them up with her show.
Yes. The Mutt Carry. Do you remember Mutt Carry came up with Johnny Dodds in a four-piece band with Mary and Mary Mack?
